speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have experienced persistent bleeding after a wisdom tooth extraction and a history of easy bruising; have you noticed any other bleeding episodes, such as from your nose or gums, or any family history of bleeding problems?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency).

The family history of an affected uncle with joint swelling strongly suggests an X-linked recessive bleeding disorder. I will request specific coagulation studies to confirm the diagnosis.

REQUEST TEST: PT, PTT, Factor VIII activity, Factor IX activity.
